title: 《比特尔特岛：与她们共度的日常》
description:
A Romance-Focused Slice-of-Life Story on a Remote IslandThis is a romance and everyday-life visual novel set on a quiet island.

Due to a certain turning point, you leave your former life behind and arrive on a small island far away from the city.
Here, time flows more slowly than you might expect.
The daily weather, the sound of the wind, and even the pace of conversations feel different from the world you once knew.

As you spend time with the island’s residents, you gradually become part of their lives and meet several girls with distinct personalities.
Relationships do not change all at once, but instead evolve slowly through seemingly ordinary conversations, choices, and everyday moments.

When you finally look back, you may realize that those simple, unremarkable days have quietly become the beginning of something more.

Romanceable Characters◆ Lana Dolly

Her appearance marks the beginning of your life on the island.

Mysterious yet free-spirited, cheerful and innocent, she greets everything with a smile.
Her straightforward words and actions naturally bring her closer to you.

◆ Hinata Rin

One of the first girls you meet on the island, Hinata Rin is calm and reserved, carrying the quiet presence of a traditional shrine maiden.

As you talk with the island’s residents, you begin to notice that her identity seems to be connected to the island’s former shrine maiden—though the truth remains unspoken.

※ More interactive characters and story routes will be added gradually in future updates.

◆ Linda Risley

(Next character route update)

A woman you meet by chance in a mountain cave, living alone while caring for her family.

At first, she keeps others at a distance.
Through repeated conflicts and shared experiences, her attitude toward you slowly begins to change.

Game FeaturesStory-Driven Romance and Harem-Style Daily LifeThrough repeated conversations and choices, the story unfolds naturally as you spend time with the girls.
Your responses subtly influence how they feel about you, and emotional bonds are formed gradually through everyday interactions.

As relationships deepen, you will build more intimate connections with the characters you care about.
At certain points in the story, your lives will begin to change—
from sharing daily moments, to living together, getting married, and eventually experiencing a harem-style life centered around multiple characters.

What once seemed like ordinary days will slowly become moments that belong only to you.

A Relaxed Island Life SystemBeyond the main story, you are free to live on the island at your own pace.
Farming, fishing, taking a walk, or simply passing the day quietly are all part of island life.

These activities are designed to be stress-free, subtly adding variety to your experience.
Sometimes, a casual choice or a small action may lead to new conversations, encounters, or changes in your relationships with the island’s residents.

Side Stories of the Island’s ResidentsAs you explore and go about your daily life, you will gradually meet other residents of the island and hear their personal stories and worries.

Through these interactions, you will see another side of the island—
some people are still struggling with reality, while others have already made their choices.

These fragmented yet sincere stories together form the everyday scenery of island life.

Birthday Events Tied to Real TimeOn this island, time is more than just a number in the game.

When your real-world birthday arrives, the characters will remember it.
They will celebrate in their own ways—
through heartfelt words, small surprises, or moments meant only for you.

Likewise, each character has a birthday of her own.
On those days, you’ll see sides of them that rarely appear in everyday life,
and hear words that are spoken only once a year.

A Story-Within-a-Story Narrative StructureThe game includes a “story within the story” centered on a world of swords and magic.
While the two narratives appear separate on the surface, you will gradually feel its influence on the main story through dialogue, daily interactions, and certain gameplay systems.

Current Version Content• One complete, fully playable character main route

• Multiple daily events and side stories

• Core gameplay systems, including the member system and shop features

• Omikuji (fortune draw) system: draw a fortune once per day to view your luck; rare character fortunes can be unlocked after reaching certain story milestones

Planned Future Updates• New romanceable characters and story routes

• Additional daily events and side stories to further enrich island life

• New relaxed gameplay activities such as farming and fishing

As development continues and content expands, the game’s price may be adjusted accordingly.

About the DeveloperThis game is developed by a solo creator.
If you encounter any issues or would like to share feedback, feel free to reach out through the following channels:

We hope you can enjoy a peaceful and memorable time on the island.
description_short: A romance-focused visual novel about island life. After a chance encounter, you begin living on a peaceful island alongside girls with unique personalities. Build relationships through dialogue and choices, enjoy relaxed daily activities like farming and fishing, and reach different endings.
